package.name: kontrolem_state_bridge
package.description: Kontrol'Em v2 base-state bridge: a ros2_control SensorInterface that turns a base odometry topic (nav_msgs/Odometry) into the 13 floating-base scalar state interfaces on a <gpio> block, so non-joint base pose/twist from a non-custom producer (Gazebo ground truth or an external estimator) can be claimed as ordinary state interfaces (Part B4 of the v2 plan).
